What Datacurve sells

Recruits experienced developers to create coding data and test AI coding tools.

  • RL environments — Extended tasks with natural instructions and realistic tools. Measures partial progress across software and data science, plus cybersecurity, machine learning and research.
  • OTS Datasets — Ready-made, reviewed datasets. Custom work includes supervised fine-tuning (models learn from examples of desired responses), expert task records and evaluations.
  • DeepSWE — Original engineering tasks written from scratch. Handwritten checks assess behavior; tasks are not adapted from existing code changes.
  • Shipd — Pays for approved technical challenge submissions. Mars covers software engineering; Eris covers machine learning. Monte covers data science.
